<reason>CON won a competitive debate by making the vote easier: after PRO’s bread-versus-lentils ranking became the live “meaning,” CON showed that ranking was already public, so the wearable’s distinctive product was daily red-line alarm around ordinary physiology, not a missing public-health signal. PRO’s silent-disease magnitude and “people still slid” close stayed live and rhetorically sharp, but never showed why a subscription graph would succeed where knowledge failed if time, money, and food access were the bottleneck; the clipped closing also blunted crystallization.</reason>
<best_rebuttal>A’s Rebuttal 2: even a consistent bread-vs-lentils ranking was already in glycemic-index knowledge, so the CGM added repeated alarm theater rather than unique actionable truth.</best_rebuttal>
